action_summary: Two problems came back wearing the same label. Measured on main at 6aa5dab, seven of the thirteen unserved sentences in the 49-request census report FAIL__LIVE_CONTROLLER_EXECUTION, which reads like the runtime falling over. It is not: all seven are deliberate refusals, and each adapter already says which one -- POLYGLOT_REFUSED:CPP_NO_APPLICABLE_TRANSFORM, SQL_UNSUPPORTED_DDL_EDIT, PYPROJECT_ALREADY_PINNED_OR_EMPTY, NO_DECLARED_DEPENDENCY_TO_VENDOR, NO_FLAKY_TEST_DETECTED, TARGET_SYMBOL_COLLISION:add -- but the door recognised only one spelling of a refusal, SystemExit(json.dumps({'error': true, ...})), and let every RuntimeError spelling fall through to a generic execution failure. Found by grep: the <ALL_CAPS_CLASS>:<detail> convention is already uniform across roughly forty adapter classes, so nothing was invented, only read. The fix adds one regex and one branch ahead of the already-satisfied test: a RuntimeError whose message is CLASS:detail is reported as FAIL_CLOSED__CAPABILITY_REFUSED_<CLASS> with a refusal_payload, and when the class is itself a wrapper the inner reason is promoted, because CPP_NO_APPLICABLE_TRANSFORM, PYPROJECT_ALREADY_PINNED_OR_EMPTY and NO_FLAKY_TEST_DETECTED are three different problems with three different fixes. This is diagnosis, not capability: measured before and after, census served is 36 in both directions with an identical served-id set, and the capability matrix is 44 REAL / 0 FALSE / 0 DAMAGED. Declared as such.

recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: The adapter already performs this extraction correctly -- called with qualname=total and lines 3-4 it returns gate PASS and one edit -- so the refusal was never a missing capability. The derivation module already had a block that computes a span from a host function's statements; it was unreachable because the binder wrote a 0 first and because the host phrase pattern only knew 'in <name>'.
